families.derivation: numbered lines, formula semantics, justifications, cited dependencies, and a words-only traversal
families.diagram: semantic SVG or equivalent structured representation, short alternative text, long description, object list, relations, and source asset hook
families.proof: ordered proof steps with readable notation, words-only speech, labels, dependencies, and a long description
families.proof_tree: tree or flattened reading-order steps plus explicit branch/dependency metadata and a long description
families.table: caption, row/column headers, scoped cells, words-only row summaries, and a scroll container
families.tableau: nodes in deterministic reading order, branch/closure metadata, and a complete spoken traversal

future_extension_rule: unknown formal families fail closed until this versioned interface is extended and adversarially tested
native_math: unflattened and unnamed-root MathML in Read and Explore; separately authored words-only text in Listen

profile_rules.explore: pair every notation object with its conventional reading, contextual meaning, and structural description
profile_rules.listen: ordinary escaped prose only; no MathML, TeX, SVG, or symbolic operators
profile_rules.read: preserve structured notation and navigation; reject aria-label, aria-labelledby, alttext, and role=img on the MathML root; provide expandable conventional speech outside the MathML tree
profile_rules.source: expose line-addressable source excerpts and hash-bound provenance
